captions.summary: CF4 forward-mock simulator: an independent FFT box reproduces the band-limited velocity dispersion at ratio 1.02 (no shared normalisation bug), the correlated field has ~82 independent large-scale modes, and the idealised full-covariance coverage holds (min 68 percent 0.65) while the noise-only covariance under-covers. Forward-simulator coverage mechanics only; same-box regions are never independent; the two CF4 P0s stay OPEN with remediation-candidate receipts pending the PR-157 adjudication; no detection.
